name: Berkeley SoftFloat
author: John R. Hauser
upstream_modifications: None; the selected files are byte-for-byte contents of the pinned archive.
specialization: 8086-SSE (portable C NaN and integer-overflow policy only; no machine code or assembly)
build_inputs: The build selects only binary32/binary64 operations and their portable integer primitives. platform.h does not include opts-GCC.h or enable native CLZ/int128 intrinsics.
